question: How does funding paid or received at each observed Binance settlement affect the cash, NAV, and later funded size of the already-frozen 680-contract NAV-tenth account?

inputs.h1_quotes: yoyo.evaluation.cloud_close_binance_gap_repair.quotes; previously archived Binance USD-M H1 only
inputs.quote_policy: Use frozen native Binance H1 OHLC for marks and preserve original entry, exit, fee class, exit phase, and event priority.

account.selection: Use the already-frozen current actual event roster and original direction-specific native runner/2R child exits; do not rescreen, refit, or re-admit candidates.
account.entry_priority: Rejoin the frozen native paths by event_id and use their original entry_order; preserve the existing wallet admission order entry_ms, entry_order, symbol CRC32, symbol, event_id.

execution.engine: VectorBT 1.2.0 Portfolio.from_order_func with the existing reward_account.account_order callback
execution.order_behavior: All entry and exit orders are native VectorBT orders at frozen H1 entry/exit prices and phases; actual child quantity is recomputed from current NAV and free cash.
execution.funding_cashflow_formula: -signed live child quantity * observed funding_rate * settlement mark_price
execution.cash_apply_hook: Apply funding within VectorBT pre/post-segment callbacks. Debit available/free balance first; any shortfall is charged against held position margin as an explicit account liability, never as spendable cash. At later funding credits or released collateral, repay that liability before sizing the next entry; no synthetic market orders.
execution.no_fill_policy: Any planned entry or exit without a matching filled VectorBT order invalidates the account replay; do not silently drop a frozen event or claim complete NAV.

collateral_accounting.debit_order: Available balance first, then position margin.
collateral_accounting.margin_shortfall_representation: Track the amount not covered by free balance as a tracked position-margin funding liability; subtract it from economic NAV and never add it to available/free cash.
collateral_accounting.liability_repayment: Funding credits offset the liability first; after orders close and collateral becomes available, repay from positive cash/free balance before any later entry sizing.
collateral_accounting.insolvency_gate: Fail only when marked NAV after the funding liability is deducted is nonpositive; zero cash or zero free collateral alone is not bankruptcy.
collateral_accounting.model_limit: Frozen paths do not contain account leverage settings or maintenance-margin/liquidation tiers, so positive NAV is not proof that an exchange liquidation threshold was never reached.

boundary_policy.timestamp_resolution: Use exact source milliseconds; no ±1s timing inference

known_ordering.funding_before_entry: A settlement with funding_time_ms < entry_ms is before the new position opens and is not charged to that child.
known_ordering.funding_after_entry: A settlement with funding_time_ms > entry_ms and before a known exit is applied after the entry fill and before the next account sizing decision, even when it is only milliseconds later.
known_ordering.open_exit: The exact exit instant is exit_bar_ms. Earlier settlements are charged; later settlements are excluded.
known_ordering.close_exit: The exact exit instant is exit_bar_ms + 3600000. Earlier settlements are charged; later settlements are excluded.
known_ordering.intrabar_exit: A settlement in [exit_bar_ms, exit_bar_ms + 3600000] has unresolved ownership order and is boundary-sensitive.

scenarios.include_boundary: Include all known entry/exit coincidence and intrabar-exit-hour settlements. For a just-exited leg only, use its actual signed quantity cached immediately before its VectorBT exit order.
scenarios.exclude_boundary: Exclude all entry/exit coincidence and intrabar-exit-hour settlements. Interior settlements still apply to live positions.
scenarios.non_boundary: Apply only if the exact fundingTime falls within the child's known held interval; ledger rows included solely by the older ±1s collection tolerance are classified before-entry or after-exit and excluded.

boundary_policy.event_stage_order: Three H1 stages: entry/open, open-phase exits, then intrabar/close exits. Exact entry settlements post after the entry stage when included; exact open-exit settlements post after that exit using the cached pre-exit quantity; close/intrabar boundary settlements post after the exit stage using the cached quantity.
boundary_policy.accounting: Reconstruct stage cash from VectorBT order records plus explicit available-cash adjustments; economic NAV equals marked VectorBT NAV less outstanding margin funding liability. Raw Portfolio.value omits funding and the liability and must not be reported as the funded NAV.

coverage_policy.complete_gate: Require complete symbol-month windows and known rate/mark for every observed settlement before producing dynamic full NAV scenarios.
coverage_policy.incomplete_behavior: If any funding range, rate, or mark is unknown, list only known settlement cashflow scenarios on the frozen quantities; set full NAV metrics null and do not run or report a complete account replay.
coverage_policy.mark_proxy: Keep Binance official markPriceKlines 1h-open proxy rows separately counted; never treat a proxy as exact fundingRate markPrice.
coverage_policy.insufficient_cash: Funding debits consume positive available/free cash first. Any remainder is charged to position margin as a tracked liability, never as spendable balance; repay it from later funding credits or released collateral. Fail closed only if marked NAV after the liability is nonpositive. Do not top up cash or omit fees/trades.

risk.equity: Persist H1 open NAV, after-open-exit NAV, close NAV, and conservative high/low envelopes including funding cash events.
risk.drawdown_interpretation: H1 OHLC envelope is a conservative scenario bound, not proof of intrabar trade/funding order.

outputs.incomplete_receipt: Known funding scenarios only; no funded NAV metrics.

network_policy: Read existing local execution and settlement files only; no network, archive download, or collector
limits: This adapter replays the already-frozen current actual event roster and native orders; it does not reselect signals or controls.
Boundary inclusion and exclusion are separate complete cash account scenarios because funding changes subsequent position size.
Any incomplete rate/mark/month coverage prevents reporting full NAV; frozen-quantity known-fee totals remain a cashflow sensitivity only.
Leverage and maintenance-margin/liquidation tiers are unavailable; positive NAV accounting does not establish liquidation safety.
No account is promoted, registered for execution, or connected to a live order system.
